$$ \text{Area} = \frac{1}{2} |x_1(y_2 - y_3) + x_2(y_3 - y_1) + x_3(y_1 - y_2)| $$
Or, using the shoelace formula. Since the coordinates are integers, the area will be a multiple of $0.5$.
